title: Register a document question

request.details: Register question data on the document. Apply question/policy and question/precheck first. Supply title and body. If choices are necessary, put them in options on one question. A choice requiring a new attempt uses label and requires=new_attempt. Follow conversation/encoding for transport.

questions.title: Acceptance criteria
questions.body: Specify which outcome this card should verify.

response: added_item_ids identifies new questions. A choice that requires a new attempt holds the card for intervention until the attempt opens. See question/precheck for reused_answer.
errors: See question/precheck for 409 existing_answer_requires_reason. For 422 transport errors see conversation/encoding.
